title: Silent Frost
author: PeterThoeny
why: Shirogane Blue Pond (Aoiike) in winter under the night light-up: frozen, snow-capped stumps and dead larch trunks lit blue (PeterThoeny, 2024-02-13) — exact place + winter + illumination.
